bibl.note: P. Bodl. MS.Gr.class. d. 143 (P) verso. Copy of an official letter from a high-ranking official to the civic officials of the Arsinoite dated to 339, on the back of a piece cut from a composite roll of documents (P. Grenf. II, 79 = S.B. VI, 9192).
